notes: Idle threads re-pick their account whenever it could be stale, and no code path swaps a thread's model for the default any more. SessionRegistry.refreshAccount: a thread with no live process re-picks fresh (the best account for its model now), one with a process keeps its sticky pick and is dropped when the pick moved so the next send respawns under it, mid-turn threads are left to the gateway; refreshAccounts runs on every accounts snapshot that knows an account (the first covers boot, replacing the one-shot fill) and refreshAccount on session.subscribe, so coming back to a thread or opening the app shows the account its next send uses without touching the model. The Sonnet bug: the Claude default was claude-sonnet-5 on both sides and every fallback led there; the server's resolveModel swapped any id the catalog did not list for that default (send and tune then persisted it), and the renderer's post-catalog re-resolve wrote the fallback default over any session whose id did not resolve, after which the next send persisted it too. Now CATALOG.claude.defaultModel and the renderer's built-in default are claude-fable-5-1, resolveModel keeps an unknown id under the asked provider (app_start_thread refuses via modelInfo instead), and the re-resolve only rewrites a session when the native id matches.
